title: Clean Huge Rust Incremental Targets
description: Workspace clean must remove huge rustc incremental compilation directories. They currently survive because they live under the protected cargo cache: cargo/build/*/incremental and cargo/canonical-architecture/**/incremental. Deps and uplifted artifacts stay. In-progress -working sessions stay. Threshold is larger than 1 GiB per incremental directory.
summary: Workspace clean now removes rustc incremental directories larger than 1 GiB under the shared cargo cache, including canonical-architecture. In-progress -working sessions stay. Dependency units and uplifted artifacts stay. A clean run removed 1010 incremental crate caches, about 49 GiB.
